note: WHAT ELSE A PAYROLL CLOSE READS, besides attendance, leave, the salary structure, statutory heads and loan / advance recoveries (owner, 7 Oct: incentives and every other earning or deduction must reach the payslip). Each source is a register a person already fills in; an entry is paid in the payroll month its own month says, once its status is one of `statuses` (case-insensitive). Closing the same month again reads the same entries again — nothing is marked, so a regenerated month is identical. `code` is the payslip line; `tds_code` is the TDS already worked out on a commission entry.

sources.label: Bonus / encashment
sources.code_named_by_type_note: Owner, 5 Nov 2026: each bonus type is its own payslip line, printed only in a month it is paid. A type not in code_by_type pays as BONUS:<type> and prints under the type's own name; a row with no type stays BONUS.
sources.basis_note: Basis 'percent' = basis_value % of the component's FULL-MONTH amount; 'days' = basis_value × (component ÷ per_day_divisor). Components are the employee's own salary lines (BASIC, HRA, DA …) plus GROSS (monthly gross) and CTC (annual). 'fixed' or blank = the Amount typed. Employee left blank = everyone in the run.

sources.label: Clawback / reversal
sources.note: Owner, 2 Nov 2026: a commission / incentive paid on a case that bounced (Clawbacks / Reversals, or raised automatically when an entry under a scheme with 'Clawback on bounce?' is set to Clawed back) is recovered in the payroll of its month once approved.

sources.label: Manual deduction
sources.skip_types_note: Late and loss of pay are now computed from attendance, leave and the Late Login Policy, and advance EMIs by the loan / advance recovery — a manual entry of the same kind would be charged twice. They are named as a concern on the row instead.
